spike.title: B2B compatibility test
spike.intro: This test checks that Tradepass can move a company location between B2B markets on this store. It creates test companies, markets and catalogs, and removes them afterwards.
spike.devOnly: This test only runs on development stores.
spike.running: Running the test. This can take up to a minute.
spike.passed: Passed: Tradepass can assign tiers automatically on this store.
spike.failed: Didn't pass: Tradepass will use assisted tier assignment on this store.
